h: Harry Kane wins the 2026 Ballon d'Or, ahead of Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe
p: Harry Kane has been named winner of the 2026 Ballon d'Or at the ceremony in London, becoming the first Englishman to take the award in 25 years. He beat Barcelona's Lamine Yamal and PSG's Kylian Mbappe to the prize. Kane has also broken his silence after the win.
more: Burna Boy reportedly presented the Socrates Award to England's Bukayo Saka at the ceremony.
The win follows the earlier mix-up in which the winners were published online hours before the event.
